text:
morgan: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands: can we get concrete quarters for API feature releases, Console rollout pieces, and Optimize milestones so teams can update OKRs?

elaine: Short answer: aiming to land the big items this FY; details below. Will publish a one-pager later this week.

elaine: API (hosted): function/tool-calling GA targeted Q3. Minor surface changes (response metadata) in beta late Q2.

elaine: Console: per-route analytics + rollout management (canary UI + backend) staged rollout starting Q3, broad availability by end of Q4.

elaine: Optimize: suggestion engine (batching + cache hints) pilot in Q4; quant profiles dashboard v1 in Q4; GA for full Optimize suite early next year.

devon: For the Console canary: is the UI prioritized or do we land APIs first and UI second? Need to know for platform adoption.

elaine: Both prioritized. Backend APIs will be available to early partners with UI behind a feature flag. target is small beta with UI in late Q3.

patrick: Important for infra teams: will rollout configs be stored per-team or per-route? We need per-route to support product teams.

elaine: Per-route is the default model. We'll expose org-level defaults + per-route overrides.

sara: Any breaking changes expected in API shapes? Our SDKs need a heads-up for semver bumps.

elaine: We'll keep backwards-compatible defaults. Any opt-in fields will be behind flags. Expect minor semver bumps for SDKs (patch -> minor) when we add helpers for function calls.

kris: Optimize question: will recommendation compute run in Dedicated/private deployments for the initial release?

elaine: Not in v1. Hosted only initially. We plan on adding connectors for Dedicated/Private in v1.1 (roughly one quarter after hosted GA).

morgan: Can product include gating criteria in the one-pager? E.g., perf targets, error budgets, SDK coverage.

elaine: Yes, gating criteria and risk items will be included.

devon: I'll need a compatibility test matrix for the API changes. Can product/eng agree on owner?

patrick: I'll own the canary UI work and coordinate with devon on tests.

elaine: Great. Action items: 1) Product to publish timeline + gating one-pager by Friday. 2) Eng to draft API compatibility matrix next week. 3) Platform to schedule a brief sync for canary UI integration.

emily-bot: Reminder: weekly-roadmap channel will get updates every Monday starting next week.

morgan: Thanks. If folks want a quick 30m sync later this week, I'll set it up.

patrick: +1
sara: :thumbsup:

elaine: Thanks all — will loop in SDK leads and customer success for migration notes.
